plugins.description: Fixes the 'RPC error: process with name already running' bug in Claude Cowork by detecting and clearing orphaned session processes. Works on Windows and macOS.

skills.name: fix-stuck-session
skills.description: Fixes the "RPC error: process with name already running" bug in Claude Cowork. Use this skill when the user reports: "process already running", "RPC error", "session won't load", "task didn't load properly", "stuck session", "cowork not working", "can't resume session", "orphaned process", "connection aborted", "session crashed", "cowork frozen", "follow-up message fails", or any error mentioning a session name like "optimistic-stoic-knuth already running". Also trigger when the user pastes an error containing "RPC error" or "process with name" or "already running".
headings: Tier 2: Archive Session State File (Fastest Fix)
